title: Plant · Ostomy bag
subtitle: Care with dignity
short: An ostomy bag design study focused on long-term wear and everyday care.
intro: This study explores the needs of people who wear ostomy bags over extended periods. Structural concepts, physical prototypes and a gentle visual language address concerns around leakage, odour, attachment and social discomfort.
hero: Ostomy bag design study focused on emotional needs

facts.label: Design focus
facts.value: Wear stability · Attachment and emptying · Emotional experience
